h: Tinubu says opposition created the hunger and poverty it now campaigns against; Atiku calls the claim delusional
p: President Tinubu accused opposition politicians of building their campaigns on hardship they helped create. Atiku Abubakar hit back, describing the remark as delusional and questioning the state of the naira and poverty levels under the current government.
more: The exchange follows the APC campaign flag-off in Kaduna.
The opposition says it will keep pressing the government on living costs.
